headline: US Customs Releases TOYO Ethiopian Solar Cells Amid Open Commerce Probe
summary: US Customs released solar cells manufactured at TOYO's Ethiopian plant, though an ongoing US Commerce duty probe into Ethiopian solar goods remains open.
why: Customs clearances and trade investigations directly impact supply chain visibility and import costs for renewable energy companies operating internationally.

impacts.name: Solar Energy
impacts.why: Customs releases ease near-term supply constraints while duty probes maintain regulatory uncertainty.
